# Begapunk

> Begapunk is a Ningbo, China manufacturer of pneumatic rotary joints, air rotary unions, multi-passage rotary unions, and custom fluid-transfer solutions for industrial machinery. The website is available in English, German, French, Japanese, and Russian.

Begapunk serves OEM machine builders, automation companies, equipment manufacturers, and distributors. Product selection depends on the medium, pressure, rotational speed, passage count, port size, mounting method, duty cycle, and operating environment.

Standard catalog models are primarily pneumatic. Do not infer hydraulic pressure or RPM ratings from the air catalog. Begapunk manufactures custom hydraulic-oil rotary unions: typical 2-passage, custom up to 12, evaluate/manufacture up to 30 MPa (300 bar / approx 4350 psi) as a custom ceiling, not a stock catalog rating. Inquiry review starts from operating pressure and speed. https://www.begapunk.com/custom-hydraulic-rotary-unions.html

Catalog models include a downloadable STEP AP214 file for a fit check on each product page. Custom or non-catalog CAD is provided after inquiry.

Use the language edition that best matches the user's query. Technical model codes, pressure values, speed values, dimensions, and material designations are shared across language editions and must not be translated or inferred beyond the published page data.

- [English homepage](https://www.begapunk.com/): Default English edition.
- [Deutsche Startseite](https://www.begapunk.com/de/): German edition for German-language queries.
- [Accueil en français](https://www.begapunk.com/fr/): French edition for French-language queries.
- [日本語ホームページ](https://www.begapunk.com/ja/): Japanese edition for Japanese-language queries.
- [Русская главная страница](https://www.begapunk.com/ru/): Russian edition for Russian-language queries.
- [Complete multilingual sitemap](https://www.begapunk.com/sitemap-i18n.xml): Index of all published English, German, French, Japanese, and Russian URLs.
- [Deutscher AI-Seitenindex](https://www.begapunk.com/de/llms.txt): Vollständiger deutschsprachiger Seitenindex mit lokalisierten Beschreibungen.

## Product models

Published values: maximum pressure 1 MPa, maximum speed 500 RPM, temperature range -20 to +80 °C, weight 270 g, Grade 45 carbon steel body, PTFE seal with O-ring, media: air, oil, water; port annotations: media inlet: 1 × G3/8; media outlet: 1 × M10×1.5.

## Application guides

- [Custom hydraulic rotary unions](https://www.begapunk.com/custom-hydraulic-rotary-unions.html): Custom hydraulic-oil rotary unions for excavators, log/timber grapples, and marine reel and coil-handling equipment. Typical 2-passage, custom up to 12. Evaluate/manufacture up to 30 MPa (300 bar / approx 4350 psi) as a custom ceiling, not a stock rating. Carbon-fiber Glyd ring (PTFE slide ring). MOQ 1; completed within 30 calendar days after payment (not the catalog pneumatic ~20-day item). Application photos/drawings of hydraulic jobs are being prepared. BP-1P-0003 is a different offer: drawing-listed air/oil/water at published 1 MPa / 500 RPM.
- [Laser tube cutting rear chucks](https://www.begapunk.com/application-laser-tube-cutting.html): Pneumatic rotary-union selection for compressed-air circuits at the rotating rear chuck. BP-2P-08-0001 and BP-3P-0004 are used in this application category.
- [CNC pneumatic clamping](https://www.begapunk.com/application-cnc-pneumatic-clamping.html): Selection guidance plus a customer-authorized BP-2P-130-0001 production application on a custom low-speed circular-saw fixture, using two independent compressed-air passages for clamp and release.
- [Vacuum packaging machines](https://www.begapunk.com/application-vacuum-packaging-machines.html): Vacuum and pneumatic rotary-union selection.
- [Welding positioners](https://www.begapunk.com/application-welding-positioners.html): Air rotary unions for positioners and rotary welding tables.
- [Textile, printing, and converting equipment](https://www.begapunk.com/application-textile-printing-converting.html): Rotary-union selection for continuous web machinery.
- [Electronics and battery test fixtures](https://www.begapunk.com/application-electronics-battery-test-fixtures.html): Pneumatic transfer for rotating test fixtures.
- [Steel and dusty environments](https://www.begapunk.com/application-steel-dusty-environments.html): Dust-resistant rotary-joint selection for harsh industrial settings.
- [BP-2P-95-0005 pneumatic chuck integration case](https://www.begapunk.com/case-bp-2p-95-pneumatic-chuck-integration.html): BP-2P-95-0005 supplies compressed air from the stationary side to the rotating chuck in this customer installation; the workshop photos show the mounting position and hose routing.
- [BP-3P-S06-0001 sensor-monitored pneumatic chuck case](https://www.begapunk.com/case-bp-3p-s06-sensor-monitored-chuck.html): BP-3P-S06-0001 combines three pneumatic passages for clamp, unclamp, and blow-off functions with transfer paths for external sensor signals in a rotating chuck.

- [Packaging machinery](https://www.begapunk.com/application-packaging-machinery.html): Packaging machinery air rotary unions: circuit, flow, speed, and mounting planning. Standard catalog models are pneumatic; send the machine layout for a model review.
- [Bottle filling and capping](https://www.begapunk.com/application-bottle-filling-capping.html): Bottle filling and capping air rotary unions, including a customer-authorized BP-2P-16-0001 production capping-head installation.
- [Automation rotary tables](https://www.begapunk.com/application-automation-rotary-tables.html): Automation rotary-table air rotary unions: clamp, release, blow-off, and mounting inputs for an engineering review.
- [Pneumatic tools and hose anti-twist](https://www.begapunk.com/application-pneumatic-tools-hose-anti-twist.html): Air-swivel planning for pneumatic tools and hose anti-twist. Confirm pressure, speed, and hose routing before selecting a catalog model. An air swivel is not a high-speed rotary union by default.
- [Robot end-of-arm tooling](https://www.begapunk.com/application-robot-end-of-arm-tooling.html): Robot end-of-arm tooling air rotary unions: passage functions, payload envelope, and cycle inputs for model comparison.

## Engineering and support

- [Selection guide](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-rotary-joint-selection.html): Five key parameters for selecting a pneumatic rotary joint.
- [Model comparison](https://www.begapunk.com/product-comparison.html): Side-by-side model data for preliminary selection.
- [Installation instructions](https://www.begapunk.com/installation.html): Installation and commissioning guidance.
- [Installation mistakes](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-rotary-joint-installation-mistakes.html): Common installation errors that can shorten service life.
- [Seal types](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-rotary-union-seal-types.html): Comparison of O-ring, lip-seal, and spring-energized PTFE designs.
- [Non-contact clearance-seal operating principle](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-non-contact-clearance-seal-rotary-union.html): Visual explanation of the stationary stator, rotating rotor, medium flow path, and controlled 0.003 mm one-side radial clearance.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.begapunk.com/faq.html): Answers about media, pressure, speed, installation, maintenance, and customization.

- [Leaking rotary union](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-rotary-joint-leaking.html): Diagnostic guide for a leaking rotary union: locate the leak, separate fittings from seals, and check alignment before replacing parts.
- [Threaded vs flange mounting](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-threaded-vs-flange.html): Threaded vs flange mounting for rotary unions: envelope, alignment, anti-rotation, and service access.
- [Seal replacement](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-seal-replacement.html): Rotary union seal replacement: inspect shafts and sealing lands, then decide reseal versus replace the union.
- [Body materials](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-rotary-joint-materials.html): Rotary union body materials: aluminum, stainless steel, and brass compared for industrial environments. Confirm the selected model's published material.

## Company

- [About Begapunk](https://www.begapunk.com/about.html): Company and manufacturing information.
- [Manufacturing & quality](https://www.begapunk.com/manufacturing-quality.html): Photo-supported overview of hard-anodized rotors, color-anodized stator housings, a single-point 51.7 μm coating-thickness reading and order-specific engineering controls.
- [100% passage-by-passage leak testing](https://www.begapunk.com/production-inspection-testing.html): Every finished pneumatic rotary union and every passage is checked individually with compressed air at 1.0 MPa before packing and storage; the page also explains PASS/NG handling.
- [Application cases and selection examples](https://www.begapunk.com/case-studies.html): Three installed rotary-union applications and two selection examples show installation layouts, circuit functions, and the inputs needed to choose a model.
- [Engineering knowledge center](https://www.begapunk.com/blog.html): Practical guides for pneumatic rotary joint selection, installation, seal comparison, application review, and production leak-testing evidence.
